lines.text: Carrying His own cross, Jesus goes to Golgotha, where they crucify Him with two others, one on each side.
Pilate posts a notice on the cross calling Jesus the King of the Jews, written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek.
The chief priests ask Pilate to change the sign, and Pilate agrees to rewrite it.

wrong_details.true: Pilate refuses, saying "What I have written, I have written."

lines.text: The soldiers divide His garments into three parts and cast lots for the seamless tunic.

wrong_details.true: four parts, one for each soldier

lines.text: Jesus says "I am thirsty," receives sour wine on a sponge on hyssop, says "It is finished," and yields up His spirit.
